To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) The FIRST algorithm is a promising method for feature tracking in VSR; (ii) A novel approach to VSD using the FIRST algorithm, was successfully applied to EP, achieving promising results; (iii) The use of ADS is a viable approach for SSI in EP, achieving promising recognition rates; (iv) The combination of ADS with the FIRST algorithm is an interesting approach to VSR in EP.

we have developed a multimodal SSI for EP, that is able to recognize the spoken digits 1 to 9, using the combination of ADS and VSR, and that the VSR approach is able to achieve an accuracy of 93.5% for the spoken digits 0 to 9, when using a 5 second long video sequence as input, with an average of 0.7 seconds of processing time per frame.

(1) the proposed VSR approach is able to extract information from the visual speech production process in EP, (2) the proposed ADS approach is able to detect glottal activity in EP, and (3) the results obtained with both approaches are encouraging and provide a solid foundation for future work.
